TWITTER_API_KEY.description: Twitter API v2 key for authentication.

TWITTER_API_SECRET_KEY.description: Twitter API v2 secret key paired with the API key for authentication.

TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: OAuth access token for Twitter API v2 requests.

TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET.description: OAuth access token secret used with the access token for authentication.

TWITTER_TARGET_USERS.description: Comma-separated list of Twitter usernames the bot should interact with. Use '*' for all users.

TWITTER_RETRY_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when a Twitter operation fails.

TWITTER_SEARCH_ENABLE.description: Enable timeline monitoring and interaction processing.

TWITTER_DRY_RUN.description: When true, all Twitter actions are simulated and nothing is actually posted.

TWITTER_POST_INTERVAL_MIN.description: Minimum interval in minutes between automatically generated posts.

TWITTER_POST_INTERVAL_MAX.description: Maximum interval in minutes between automatically generated posts.

TWITTER_POST_IMMEDIATELY.description: Skip intervals and post immediately after generation.

TWITTER_POST_INTERVAL_VARIANCE.description: Random variance factor (0.0-1.0) applied to posting intervals for natural behavior.

TWITTER_INTERACTION_INTERVAL_MIN.description: Minimum interval in minutes between interactions.

TWITTER_INTERACTION_INTERVAL_MAX.description: Maximum interval in minutes between interactions.

TWITTER_INTERACTION_INTERVAL_VARIANCE.description: Random variance factor (0.0-1.0) applied to interaction intervals for natural behavior.

TWITTER_TIMELINE_USER_BASED_WEIGHT.description: Weight for user-based scoring in weighted timeline algorithm.

TWITTER_TIMELINE_TIME_BASED_WEIGHT.description: Weight for time-based scoring in weighted timeline algorithm.

TWITTER_TIMELINE_RELEVANCE_WEIGHT.description: Weight for relevance-based scoring in weighted timeline algorithm.

TWITTER_MAX_TWEET_LENGTH.description: Maximum tweet length (supports long-form tweets up to 4000 characters).

TWITTER_MAX_INTERACTIONS_PER_RUN.description: Maximum number of interactions processed per cycle.

TWITTER_DM_ONLY.description: Only process direct messages, ignore public interactions.

TWITTER_ENABLE_ACTION_PROCESSING.description: Enable timeline action processing and automated responses.

TWITTER_ACTION_INTERVAL.description: Interval in minutes between timeline action processing cycles.
